mapper.select: SELECT pcd.id, pcd.create_time, pcd.update_time, pcd.purchase_price_change_id, pcd.sku_id, pcd.sku_no, pcd.min_qty, pcd.max_qty, pcd.currency, pcd.tax_price, pcd.effective_date, pcd.expire_date, pcd.tax_rate, pcd.purchase_price_detail_id, pcd.delivery_day, pcd.disabled, pcd.remark FROM purchase_price_change_detail pcd INNER JOIN purchase_price_change pc ON pcd.purchase_price_change_id=pc.id and pc.is_deleted=false WHERE pcd.is_deleted=false AND pc.approve_status='approve'
